name: Being Mean
overview: Scripture warns believers against harboring envy or anger toward evildoers, urging them instead to trust in the Lord and avoid evil (Psalms 37:1; Proverbs 3:7). Wisdom is cultivated through association with the wise and is demonstrated in gentle speech that defuses wrath rather than provokes it (Proverbs 13:20; 15:1). The health of our spirit is closely tied to the words we speak, as a wholesome tongue brings life, while perverseness causes spiritual harm (Proverbs 15:4). Ultimately, all have sinned and fall short of God's glory, highlighting our need for grace when confronting meanness in ourselves and others (Romans 3:23).
